Let <MATH_0001> be a morphism of algebraic stacks.
Let <MATH_0002> be a point. To indicate the equivalent
conditions of Lemma <REF_0001>
are satisfied for <MATH_0003> and <MATH_0004> in the literature the terminology
<TEXTITOPEN_0001><MATH_0005> is stabilizer preserving at <MATH_0006><TEXTITCLOSE_0001> or
<TEXTITOPEN_0002><MATH_0007> is fixed-point reflecting at <MATH_0008><TEXTITCLOSE_0002> is used.
We prefer to say <TEXTITOPEN_0003><MATH_0009> induces an isomorphism between
automorphism groups at <MATH_0010> and <MATH_0011><TEXTITCLOSE_0003>.
